recommendedFixesPriority.action: Unify host: enforce single 301 (apex↔www) at CDN/server; align GSC property with live canonical host.
Resolve seo.js vs product-detail.js canonical race on PDP (single source of truth; avoid 800ms overwrite conflicting with location.origin).
Remove tent-detail.html from sitemap OR remove noindex—pick one indexing policy.
Replace relative canonical (index.html) on test/wireframe/original with absolute www URLs or leave disallowed-only.
Add static fallback text in <title> for data-translate-only pages (dome-type, furniture-type, products-accessories) for crawlers without JS.
Review PDP template duplication: unique paragraphs/spec copy per high-value SKU where possible to reduce soft-duplicate risk.
